none: PAS NLM-B09745: Roman Coin: Radiate indeterminate
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Probably a Radiate indeterminate, issue of 260-300. Pitted overall. Obverse description: Bust right, only the clean- shaven face is on flan. Obverse inscription: (--)S PF AVG. Reverse description: Figure standing left, possibly soldier - perhaps Fides; part off flan. Reverse inscription: (--)[---]AVG. Diameter: 15.2mm, Weight: 1.30gms, die axis: 6
